toolsPreview.name: get_ai_transparency_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: Returns the free tools, accepted bounded facts, privacy behavior, source ruleset and truth boundaries before a scenario is submitted.

toolsPreview.name: scan_ai_transparency_surface
toolsPreview.description: Reads bounded static homepage signals from one public HTTP or HTTPS website. Returns observed, not-observed and manual-review evidence without source text, a compliance score or legal certification. Private and local networks are blocked.

toolsPreview.name: build_ai_transparency_notice
toolsPreview.description: Maps bounded deployment facts to a review-oriented Article 50 assessment and returns deployable HTML plus a privacy-minimized checksummed manifest. Omitted facts are treated as unsure. No names, model identifiers or free text are accepted.

toolsPreview.name: verify_ai_transparency_manifest
toolsPreview.description: Checks the schema and canonical SHA-256 digest of an H/M AI transparency deployment manifest. It does not authenticate an issuer or certify legal compliance.
